headline: President Bush amended a 1999 executive order aimed at increasing Asian American and Pacific Islander participation in federal programs.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 13125, a 1999 order meant to increase the participation of Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders in federal programs. The title does not say which parts were changed or how. No summary was provided, so the specific changes cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order changes the rules of an earlier effort to increase their participation in federal programs, though the specific changes are not described in the source.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run programs covered by Executive Order 13125
who_it_affects.how: They may have to follow updated directions under the amended order, but the details are not given in the source.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 6, 2001; no separate effective date is given in the source.
